definitions.explanation: Rice that has been milled to remove the bran and germ, resulting in the familiar white grains commonly eaten in Japan.

examples.japanese: {白米|はくまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
{白米|はくまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三合|さんごう}→三合：noentry⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧。
examples.english: To wash three cups of white rice.
examples.notes: {研|と}ぐ means to rinse rice before cooking

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白米|はくまい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: White rice is the staple food of Japanese people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊|た}きたて→炊きたて：15234_takitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白米|はくまい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Freshly cooked white rice is very delicious.

examples.japanese: {白米|はくまい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べると→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{食|た}べやすくて→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: White rice has less nutrition than brown rice, but it's easy to eat and popular.

notes:
USAGE:
{白米|はくまい} is polished rice, the most common form of rice eaten in Japan. The word ⟦{精白米|せいはくまい}→精白米：noentry⟧ is a more formal/technical term.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {白米|はくまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (cook white rice)
- {白米|はくまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (rinse white rice)
- ⟦{炊|た}きたて→炊きたて：15234_takitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白米|はくまい} (freshly cooked white rice)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (cooked rice - everyday word)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (uncooked rice - general)
- ⟦{精米|せいまい}→精米：06615_seimai⟧ (rice polishing/polished rice)
